thread:
maria: Quick sync — finalizing post-event replay flow for Monday micro-lab. Objectives: 72h public replay, clip highlights to HubSpot, and test two CTA variants on the reg page.
kevin: Sounds good. Zoom settings ready? I need to confirm cloud recordings + SRT captions enabled.
olivia: I can toggle captions and auto-recording on the Zoom side. Reminder: for SRT we need the host to enable 'Save Captions'.
maria: @olivia please enable. Also, we want a small email sequence: immediate registrant confirm, 24h reminder, and replay follow-up with clip pack.
sam: For the CTA A/B test on the reg page, are we doing variant A = 'Join Live' vs B = 'Reserve Replay'? Small wording change only.
kevin: Yes. We'll put a hidden query param ?cta=live or ?cta=replay so post-event clicks map back to each variant. HubSpot form should capture cta param.
olivia: I'll add the JS snippet to the reg page. Use this (will paste in prod after review):
```html
<script>
  const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const cta = params.get('cta') || 'control';
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-cta-field]').forEach(el => el.value = cta);
</script>
```
maria: Perfect. Who owns clip extraction after recording lands in S3? We want 3x 30s highlight clips + full replay.
kevin: @events-bot will trigger the clip extractor lambda when recording appears. Clip spec: start offsets [00:04:10, 00:23:05, 00:39:40]. I'll add markers during the session for backup.
events-bot: Recording uploaded: s3://redwood-recordings/micro-lab/3741592637.mp4 — clip job queued. :white_check_mark:
hubspot-sync-bot: Lead capture: form submitted 132 new registrants. Mapping: cta -> hs_cta_variant, recording_link -> replay_url (populated after clip job completes).
olivia: Timeline: recordings visible in S3 within 20-30m after the meeting ends, clips + caption SRT ready within 90m. We'll then kick off transcript generation and social-ready snippet creation.
maria: Good. For the replay email, copy draft below — pls quick edit: "Missed it? Watch the full replay + 3 highlights. Choose 'Watch Live' or 'Reserve Replay' to tell us what you prefer."
sam: Minor tweak: change 'Watch Live' to 'Watch Full Replay' to avoid confusion.
maria: Done. Also, add UTM params to all links: utm_source=microlab, utm_campaign=mar-launch, utm_content={cta}. e.g., https://replay.redwood.ai/watch?file=3741592637.mp4&utm_source=microlab&utm_campaign=mar-launch&utm_content=live
kevin: On routing, HubSpot workflow should: 1) tag registrant with cta_variant, 2) if cta=replay then send replay drip, else send live-reminder. Can someone create the workflow?
olivia: I will set up tags and the workflow steps today.
sam: Who owns post-event analytics? We need CTR per CTA, replay watch rate, and conversion MQLs from clip CTA.
maria: @kevin you'll get the analytics export — combine HubSpot + streaming watch metrics. Report due Wed EOD.
events-bot: Reminder: Zoom live stream auto-archival set to ON. Recording retention policy: 90 days.
kevin: One more: enable SRT packaging for Zoom transcript so caption timestamps align with clip offsets.
olivia: Done. Also scheduling a 30m playback QA slot 2 hours after event to spot-check caption sync + clip timestamps.
maria: Excellent. Last thing: social snippets — @sam can you pick 3 quotes from the session and add branding overlays? Need by T+6h.
sam: Yep. Will use the three highlight clips. Pls confirm brand pack location: https://assets.redwood.ai/brand/mar-pack.zip
maria: Confirmed. Thanks team — I'll post the final reg page with variant toggles at 10:30 PDT. :rocket:
